methods.C: performance curriculum; shortest independently validated feasible scale
methods.D: same start scale as C; fixed-iteration curriculum

primary_endpoint: full-scale standing-start five-second success, averaged within training seed
secondary_endpoints: recovery after 0.3 rad/s pitch velocity increment at 2 seconds
statistics: Report seed-level mean, std and paired differences. Ten training seeds; do not treat evaluation episodes as independent training runs.
required_before_extended_training: Independent improved-feasibility validation and adequate full-scale fine-tuning budget; pilot alone is not sufficient.
